main_text.p: cari probatur, quid ni ex principio illo supernaturali etiam de nocte & in somniis optimæ cogitationes, inspirationesque, hoc agente Spiritu, suboriri queant? Practicos consule & videbis non frustra hæc dici. Ego, ut inclinationes peccaminosas, præsertim quæ peccata in deliciis vocant, sic & spiritualis internique hominis magis aut minus vividum in his aut illis statum hinc dignosci sæpe posse nullus dubito.

Cant. v.1.Hoc etiam sensu aliquando pia anima, sponsa Christi, dormit animo interim vigilante. Pios roga quanti faciant γνωρίσματα dispositionis tam naturalis quam spiritualis, quæ inde desumere se posse sciunt: peccaminosa somnia, (ut viscidi humores talis unde prodeunt, fundi) cordis indices sæpe sunt: sic è contra gaudere solent pii, quando evigilantes & quæ vel somniarunt examinantes, bonorum motuum [co-piam in corde suo fuisse vident. Quid ni & sic Davidem renes docuerunt? non decet autem Pastores illius incertos esse, quod piis omnibus, quotquot aliquo vitæ Spiritualis majori tanguntur sensu, expertum est, tam sæpe tam certò. Applica huc Analogicè quæ alibi de somnio Zuinglii Spanhemius, qui extraordinariam in eo suggestionem agnoscens, nihil minùs tamen quam Enthusiastis favet, refutat eos solidè & perspicue vir summus. Ex inspiratione extraordinaria, immediata, probari putabant suos Enthusiasmos, sic autem respondet Spanhemius.

I. Peccari falsa suppositione, omnes inspirationes extraordinarias à nobis damnari. At NB nemo verè pius est, qui tales non persentiscat sæpe in corde suo. Scrutemur jam coram Domino, excutiamus nos Wolzogi,

page.notes: Printed line ends and the catchword "sed" are at the foot right; the catchword is kept out of the text. Doubtful readings: the bracket before "copiam" (read as "[co-") and the Greek phrase in thesis II (παρὰ [?]τὸ ἐπομένον, the middle letters are uncertain). The Greek in "γνωρίσματα" is read from the scan. The opening of "Ego, ut inclinationes" is not visibly indented, so it is kept in the same paragraph as the preceding lines. Running head reads "Pro genuina Reformat. sentent." with the last word abbreviated as printed. The right margin shows show-through and the neighbouring page edge and is left out.
